earnings.title: Amcor Reports Solid Results for
highlights: Net sales of $6,129 million up 7% over prior-year
Diluted EPS of $0.52; Adjusted Diluted EPS of $0.95
outlook: For the Transition Period, the Company is lowering its outlook for Adjusted EPS to $1.70 to $1.80 from $1.80 to $1.90 due to the timing of pass-through of higher energy and distribution costs.

items.heading: Changes in Consumer Demand — Demand for our products could be affected by a variety of factors, including economic conditions and regulatory developments.

Key Customers and Customer Consolidation — The loss of key customers, a reduction in their production requirements or consolidation among key customers could have a significant adverse impact on our sales revenue and profitability.
Competition — We face significant competition in the industries and regions in which we operate, which could adversely affect our business.
Integration — We may face challenges with integrating acquisitions and achieving the financial and other results and benefits anticipated at the time of acquisition.

Strategic Review of Portfolio — Our strategic review of our portfolio may cause disruptions to our business, may not result in the completion of transactions to restructure or divest all non-core businesses, and may not create additional value for our shareholders.
Expanding Our Current Business — We may be unable to expand our current business effectively through organic growth, investments, or acquisitions.
